game.name: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition Unofficial Category Extensions
game.rules:
# General Rules
* All runs must be performed on the Bedrock Edition of Minecraft (Education Edition is not allowed)
* The use of **glitches are not allowed**, unless explicitly stated in individual category rules
* The use of any external tools that modify the game are not allowed
* The use of some texture packs and resource packs are allowed, but those which give an advantage to the runner are not allowed (we recommend talking to moderators for specific packs)
* The use of the beta versions or any versions before 1.16 are **not allowed** for set seed runs, and for random seed runs any betas or past versions that provide the runner an advantage are also not allowed
    * An example of a banned run is to use the 1.16 beta versions for perfect rng
    * An example of a legal run is to run categories like 'Build an L' while running on older versions

# Proof Rules
* All runs must be submitted with **video evidence**, that is accessible to moderators - twitch runs are banned, and as such runners should aim to upload their run to YouTube
* The video must show the **world creation process** (creating the world) and the entire run
* Editing the video in any way that affects the final time of the run is not allowed - this includes splicing (cuts) in the middle of the run, and speeding up the video
    * Any evidence found that the video of a run, or the run itself, has been altered in any way to give an advantage, will result in a ban from the leaderboards

# Timing Rules
* Timing starts on the first frame of movement
    * This includes moving the camera, moving the player, opening the inventory, or mining/hitting
    * This does not include changing perspectives, the pause menu, and typing in chat
    * You may wait (for a reasonable amount of time) to load in the world
* Timing ends depending on the category - for example, for most 'Obtain' categories, timing ends when the final item is in the inventory
* All full game runs (with the exception of All Effects) are retimed by RTA No Loads, while all other categories are retimed with RTA

# World Settings
* Required world settings include:
    * Gamemode: Survival
    * Difficulty: Easy, Normal, or Hard (must **not be peaceful**)
    * **Starting Map: Disabled**
    * **Bonus Chest: Disabled**
    * World Type: Infinite
    * Friendly Fire: Enabled
    * Fire Spreads: Enabled
    * TNT Explodes: Enabled
    * Mob Loot: Enabled
    * Tile Drops: Enabled
* Immediate respawn is allowed
* Show co-ordinates are allowed
* All experimental features must be disabled
* Cheats must be disabled, and in game commands are not allowed during the run - any glitches exploited to use in game commands are also not allowed

categories.name: Obtain Item (No Structures)
categories.rules:
* Must obtain the selected item
* Must **not** use in game structures, such as:
    * Items from pre-generated chests (villages, dungeons, temples)
    * Any blocks or mobs (that would not otherwise be found) from structures
* Rules regarding timing will depend on the category

categories.name: Obtain Enchanted Apple
categories.rules:
* Must obtain an enchanted golden apple
* Timing ends first frame enchanted golden apple is visible in inventory

categories.name: Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles
categories.rules:
* Must obtain blue, yellow, and red dyes
* Timing ends when the final dye is visible in the inventory
* You must have all the dyes in your inventory at the end of the run

categories.name: Kill Iron Golem
categories.rules:
* Must kill an iron golem
* Timing ends on the frame that the golem has disappeared

categories.name: Any% Creative
categories.rules:
* Must be played in creative mode
* **No commands** must be executed during the run
* Timing ends on the first frame credits fade in
* Unlike other categories, timing begins if you open your inventory

categories.name: Any% Blindfolded
categories.rules:
* Must beat the game blindfolded
* Due to the nature of the category, a facecam is required (enough of the facecam to prove that you are blindfolded)
* you may have ONE other person who is able to see the game to help you. this person may not have use any input device into the game, and must instead only verbally communicate with the runner
* Timing ends on the first frame credits fade in

categories.name: All Swords
categories.rules:
* Must obtain all swords in the respective split
* Timing ends when the final sword is visible in the inventory
* You must have all the swords in your inventory at the end of the run

categories.rules: MONo

categories.name: MONO

categories.name: Obtain Item
categories.rules:
* Must obtain the selected item
* Rules regarding timing will depend on the category

categories.name: Obtain Item (No Structures)
categories.rules:
* Must obtain the selected item
* Must **not** use in game structures, such as:
    * Items from pre-generated chests (villages, dungeons, temples)
    * Any blocks or mobs (that would not otherwise be found) from structures
* Rules regarding timing will depend on the category

categories.name: Height Limit
categories.rules:
* Must reach the height limit
* Timing ends when the height limit message appears in chat

categories.name: Finish Raid
categories.rules:
* Must finish a raid

* Timing ends on the first frame the player receives the 'Hero of the Village' effect

categories.name: Cure Zombie Villager
categories.rules:
* Must cure a villager
* Timing ends when the zombie villager turns into a normal villager

categories.name: Perfect RNG
categories.rules:
* Must use a valid behaviour pack that only changes loot that is possible (e.g. you can't drop 2 rods from a blaze)
* While not required, it is recommended that behaviour packs are sent to mods before the run to ensure that it is valid
* Along with the video evidence, the run description must also contain a link of the world file uploaded
* Timing ends on the first frame credits fade in

categories.name: Set Seed Solo
categories.rules:
* Run must be performed on a set seed
* No other players can join the world

categories.name: Random Seed Solo
categories.rules:
* Run must be performed on a random seed
* You must not view the seed until the run has finished

categories.name: Any% Icarus
categories.rules:
* Must use Icarus Pack (pack in resources)
    * Must be the pack with the bonus chest
* Timing ends on the first frame credits fade in

* For console runs only
     * Cheats can be activated to use the /give command.
     * Creative mode is NOT allowed
     * You must use the /give command before you do your first movement (to give you an unenchanted elytra and 64 regular firework rockets only)
     * Timing begins once the first command message is sent in chat

categories.name: Any% Icarus + Perfect RNG
categories.rules:
* Must use the Icarus data pack (can be found in the discord server)
* Must use a perfect RNG data pack (can be found in the discord server)

categories.name: Set Seed Coop
categories.rules:
* Run must be performed on a set seed
* Must have at least one other contributing player

categories.name: Random Seed Coop
categories.rules:
* Run must be performed on a random
* You must not view the seed until the run has finished
* Must have at least one other contributing player

categories.name: Start in Nether
categories.rules:
- Must use the Start in Nether Pack (link in the discord server)
- Must enable bonus chest (it is against the rules to use the bonus chest)
- Timing ends on the first frame credits fade in

categories.name: Scouted Seed Glitchless
categories.rules:
* You have 10 minutes to scout and route a randomly generated seed in creative mode. The use of commands is allowed (This part must be recorded as well.)

* Then you must start a new world in survival with the seed that you just scouted, and play it out. (The official time of the run will only be the actual speedrun.)

categories.name: All Effects
categories.rules:
* Must have all effects, which includes the following:
    * Absorption
    * Bad Omen
    * Blindness
    * Conduit Power
    * Fire Resistance
    * Haste
    * Hero of the Village
    * Hunger
    * Invisibility
    * Jump Boost
    * Levitation
    * Mining Fatigue
    * Nausea
    * Night Vision
    * Poison
    * Regeneration
    * Resistance
    * Slow Falling
    * Slowness
    * Speed
    * Strength
    * Water Breathing
    * Weakness
    * Wither
* Here is an image of all effects on the screen https://imgur.com/f00Bre4
* The run must be played on 1.13 or later
* Timing ends the frame the last effect appears on the screen

categories.name: Height Limit Coop
categories.rules:
* Must reach the height limit
* Must be played with more than one player
* Timing ends when the height limit message appears in chat

categories.name: Any% 12 Eyes
categories.rules:
- Timing ends on the first frame credits fade in

- Getting the Ender Eyes
    - Cheats can be activated to use the /give command.
    - You can also use the 12 Eye Behavior pack found in the Discord server
    - You must use the /give command before you do your first movement (to give you 12 Eyes Of Ender only)
    - Timing begins once the first command message is sent

categories.name: Obtain All Workstations
categories.rules:
* Must obtain all unique workstations
* Timing ends when all 13 workstations are visible in your inventory
     * Here is a list of all workstations:
Blast Furnace, 
Smoker,
Cartography Table,
Brewing Stand,
Composter,
Barrel,
Fletching Table,
Cauldron,
Lectern,
Stonecutter,
Loom,
Smithing Table,
Grindstone,

categories.name: Mcdonald's Happy Meal
categories.rules:
* The player must obtain the following items. All items must be in the player's inventory at the same time.
     * 1 Cooked Steak
     * 2 Bread
     * 1 Cooked Chicken
     * 1 Apple
     * 1 Baked Potato

categories.name: Mine a Chunk
categories.rules:
- The objective is to mine out a 16x16 section entirely down to the bedrock at the bottom of the world. Timing ends when the last block is broken. Please make sure to properly show that the entire chunk has been mined out after the run is complete.
- For the "Nether" subcategory, every block up till the nether roof must be cleared as well.
- The "Pre-1.18" and "1.18+" subcategories apply to the overworld.
- To make it clear, any 16x16 area in the world can be mined out, since you cannot easily locate chunk borders in bedrock edition.

categories.name: Creative No Inventory
categories.rules:
- Must be on Creative Mode
- Using the Creative Menu is not allowed, however you can use the regular player inventory
- Player can use Pick Block and open chests to obtain loot
- The usage of commands is banned
- Timing ends on the first frame credits fade in

categories.name: Specific Seed Glitchless
categories.rules:
This category has the same basis as Set Seed Glitchless, except there are specific seeds chosen.

These are "-190758954", "-953272745", "-1498723043" for 1.16, and "-7202661002741798908" for 1.18+

categories.name: Master
categories.rules:
- Must level up a villager to the max level by trading 

- Time starts on first movement

- Time ends when the villager reaches the last level and the text in the trading ui says "Max Level"

levels.name: Kill Iron Golem
levels.rules:
* Must kill an iron golem
* Timing ends when the iron golem disappears upon death

levels.name: Build an L
levels.rules:
* Must build an 'L' shape
    * All blocks must be placed by the player
    * The L must be in formation of a regular L which contains 6 blocks (4 vertical and 3 horizontal)
* Timing ends when the last block is placed. The block must fully appear placed (the full block, not just the outline of the block)

levels.name: All Swords
levels.rules:
* Must obtain all swords in the respective split
* Timing ends when the final sword is visible in the inventory
* You must have all the swords in your inventory at the end of the run

levels.name: Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles
levels.rules:
* Must dye 3 sheep red, orange and blue
* Timing ends when all 3 sheep are dyed

levels.name: jeb_
levels.rules:
* Must name a sheep "jeb_"
* Timing ends when the name tag is no longer visible in the hotbar

levels.name: dank%
levels.rules:
* Must put a dried kelp block on fire
* Timing ends when the fire is placed on the dried kelp block

levels.name: Hydrated
levels.rules:
* Must drink a bottle of water
* Timing ends when the bottle is empty

values.rules:
- Must be performed on a superflat world in survival mode.
- When creating a superflat world, creative mode is forced in some versions of the game. Upon spawning, you **must change to survival mode** before starting the run, if the player moves while in creative the run will be invalidated. This will also mean cheats are going to be on, and this **cannot be abused in any way**. Otherwise, this will result in a rejection.

categories.name: Obtain Item
categories.rules:
* Must obtain the selected item
* Rules regarding timing will depend on the category

categories.name: Perfect RNG
categories.rules:
* Must use a valid behaviour pack that only changes loot that is possible (e.g. you can't drop 2 rods from a blaze)
* While not required, it is recommended that behaviour packs are sent to mods before the run to ensure that it is valid
* Along with the video evidence, the run description must also contain a link of the world file uploaded
* Timing ends on the first frame credits fade in

categories.name: Set Seed Solo
categories.rules:
* Run must be performed on a set seed
* No other players can join the world

categories.name: Random Seed Solo
categories.rules:
* Run must be performed on a random seed
* You must not view the seed until the run has finished

games.name: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition Unofficial Category Extensions
games.rules:
# General Rules
* All runs must be performed on the Bedrock Edition of Minecraft (Education Edition is not allowed)
* The use of **glitches are not allowed**, unless explicitly stated in individual category rules
* The use of any external tools that modify the game are not allowed
* The use of some texture packs and resource packs are allowed, but those which give an advantage to the runner are not allowed (we recommend talking to moderators for specific packs)
* The use of the beta versions or any versions before 1.16 are **not allowed** for set seed runs, and for random seed runs any betas or past versions that provide the runner an advantage are also not allowed
    * An example of a banned run is to use the 1.16 beta versions for perfect rng
    * An example of a legal run is to run categories like 'Build an L' while running on older versions

# Proof Rules
* All runs must be submitted with **video evidence**, that is accessible to moderators - twitch runs are banned, and as such runners should aim to upload their run to YouTube
* The video must show the **world creation process** (creating the world) and the entire run
* Editing the video in any way that affects the final time of the run is not allowed - this includes splicing (cuts) in the middle of the run, and speeding up the video
    * Any evidence found that the video of a run, or the run itself, has been altered in any way to give an advantage, will result in a ban from the leaderboards

# Timing Rules
* Timing starts on the first frame of movement
    * This includes moving the camera, moving the player, opening the inventory, or mining/hitting
    * This does not include changing perspectives, the pause menu, and typing in chat
    * You may wait (for a reasonable amount of time) to load in the world
* Timing ends depending on the category - for example, for most 'Obtain' categories, timing ends when the final item is in the inventory
* All full game runs (with the exception of All Effects) are retimed by RTA No Loads, while all other categories are retimed with RTA

# World Settings
* Required world settings include:
    * Gamemode: Survival
    * Difficulty: Easy, Normal, or Hard (must **not be peaceful**)
    * **Starting Map: Disabled**
    * **Bonus Chest: Disabled**
    * World Type: Infinite
    * Friendly Fire: Enabled
    * Fire Spreads: Enabled
    * TNT Explodes: Enabled
    * Mob Loot: Enabled
    * Tile Drops: Enabled
* Immediate respawn is allowed
* Show co-ordinates are allowed
* All experimental features must be disabled
* Cheats must be disabled, and in game commands are not allowed during the run - any glitches exploited to use in game commands are also not allowed

* Timing ends when the fire is placed on the dried kelp block

levels.name: Hydrated
levels.rules:

* Timing ends when the bottle is empty

values.name: Random Seed
values.rules:
* Run must be performed on a random seed, and the seed field must be left blank
* You must not view the seed until the run has finished

values.name: Pre 1.16
values.rules:
* Must obtain, and have, all swords on pre 1.16
    * Wooden
    * Stone
    * Gold
    * Iron
    * Diamond
* Does not need to be played in a version before 1.16

* Must obtain, and have, all swords on 1.16+
    * Wooden
    * Stone
    * Gold
    * Iron
    * Diamond
    * Netherite

values.name: Structures
values.rules:
* Must use in game structures, such as:
    * Items from pre-generated chests (villages, dungeons, temples)
    * Any blocks or mobs (that would not otherwise be found) from structures

values.name: No Structures
values.rules:
* Must **not** use in game structures, such as:
    * Items from pre-generated chests (villages, dungeons, temples)
    * Any blocks or mobs (that would not otherwise be found) from structures

values.rules:

* No other input methods are allowed
    * For example, spam clicking and also using a controller at the same time are not allowed
* Top 3 placed runs must provide a video of the runner using a click speed test in the run description

values.rules:

- When creating a superflat world, creative mode is forced in some versions of the game.
